name: etherfall
description: ETHERFALL — ASCII Souls Online (MMORPG 2D soulslike com renderização ASCII por GPU)

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @etherfall/client && npm run build -w @etherfall/server
scripts.build:single: npm run build && node tools/inline-build.mjs packages/client/dist packages/client/dist/etherfall.html
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/client && tsc -p packages/server
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run server
